sources.authors: X.-H. Cao, L.-Y. Dai, F.-K. Guo
sources.title: Precision Sum Rule for Nucleon Isovector Polarizabilities and the Proton-Neutron Mass Difference
sources.extracted: eq.(12) definition m_p-m_n = dm_QCD + dm_QED + O(e^4, e^2(m_d-m_u)); eq.(13) Cottingham form with counterterm, C ~ 6e-4 GeV^2, MSbar mu=2 GeV (eq.(15)); eq.(14) dm_QED = m_el + m_F12 + m_Sbar; m_el = 0.75(2) MeV (average over parametrisations, Refs. 99-102); m_F12 = -0.004(1) MeV; m_Sbar = -0.04(+0.03/-0.06) MeV (tripole eq.(18), M0 = 0.46 GeV; M0 ~ 0.7 GeV gives -0.17 MeV); eq.(19) dm_QED = 0.71(+0.03/-0.06) MeV; text cites the Reggeon-dominance value 0.58(16) MeV [97,98]
